name: Deen Dayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM): Support for Urban Homeless – Uttarakhand
benefit: People living under the open sky are provided with benefits in night shelters.
_eligibility_text: 1. Any person living under the open sky within the municipal areas of Uttarakhand is eligible to stay in a night shelter.
